body:
Design-only request 1e01f5e2-641a-41d6-927e-058066de920b completed in commit42ccdab8 on codex/mask-pending-retention. Note: tools/orchestrate/wp/B5-16/DOCUMENT-CLOSE-PREPARATION-DESIGN.md. Inspected main382586cf, including DocumentWorkspace save/saveAs/finishSaveAs/close/discard, DocumentSheets cancellation, controller close, Text queue/commit, brush/transform and Retouch model-wait boundaries.

Proposes independent prepareClose -> ready ticket/cancelled/blocked, commitClose with all-document preflight and exactly-once disposal, and cancelClose retaining controllers and draining admitted work. Strong ownership includes exact controller/backend identity, lifetime, mutation/draft and membership generations; existing reload revision is not an edit generation. Save/Don't Save decisions stay non-disposing until commit. Dirty missing-window blocks; no default-folder write/discard. Save As cancellation/dismissal/overwrite cancellation/errors settle once. Cancellation after admitted save drains and reports actual saved state without rollback claims.

Draft prerequisites are explicit: result-bearing Text/IME, brush, transform and debounce capture/fences, preserve local state until acknowledgement, no replay of accepted brush prefix. Unsupported busy tools/model-download work block preparation rather than implicitly complete expensive work. Multiple docs remain retained if a later prompt cancels. Ten proposed deterministic cases use injected prompts/save/draft continuations; all UNRUN. No AppModel SaveGate dependency, no product edits, no B workloads/heartbeat restart/writer changes. Diff check passed; A review and separate implementation authorization required.

Core status5ddb6abe reconciled in note as A-reported verified integration435307e3; no acknowledgement receipt for that status. It does not imply AppModel/Document recovery acceptance.
